breaking_news.headline: The skincare scheme that led to consumer complaints, lawsuits and a federal investigation
breaking_news.summary: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S.

breaking_news.headline: VIDEO: The skincare sample is free. What happens next can cost thousands
breaking_news.summary: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
breaking_news.summary: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago.  The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

breaking_news.headline: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
breaking_news.summary: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

breaking_news.headline: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
breaking_news.summary: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

breaking_news.headline: Weddings are expensive. How about a grocery store cake?
breaking_news.summary: About a third of couples are willing to save money on cake and dessert, according to the wedding-planning site Zola.

breaking_news.headline: Noah Adams, longtime host of NPR's All Things Considered, has died
breaking_news.summary: One of NPR's most gifted storytellers, his soft voice and vivid writing helped define the network's sound for a generation of Americans.

breaking_news.headline: Bomb threat forces Israel to Austria flight into emergency landing
breaking_news.summary: The Airbus jet landed safely in Bulgaria and all passengers and crew aboard were unharmed, officials said.

breaking_news.headline: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff survives shooting attempt in Mumbai
breaking_news.summary: Videos showed gunmen firing shots at Shroff's car while it was moving slowly past a crowd.

breaking_news.headline: Kenya pastor accused of ordering parents to starve their children to death faces verdict
breaking_news.summary: Prosecutors say Paul Mackenzie lured the latest victims to their deaths by writing notes from his prison cell.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says suspension of Russia sanctions is to keep peace negotiations going
breaking_news.summary: The US president blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect.

breaking_news.headline: Major fire at Canada military base leaves four dead, dozens injured
breaking_news.summary: Prime Minister Carney said military and emergency crews fought the flames throughout the night in "some of the worst conditions imaginable".

breaking_news.headline: Inside the shadowy world of anti-Putin sabotage from within Russia
breaking_news.summary: Two men tell of the work they say they have been doing to support Ukrainian intelligence during the war.

breaking_news.headline: Funding shortages force World Food Programme to cut aid to Gaza
breaking_news.summary: The number of people helped by the UN agency in the Palestinian territory will drop by about a third - from 1.6 million to 1.1 million.

breaking_news.headline: France's government under pressure after weekend of widespread violence
breaking_news.summary: Political tension grips France after rioting marred protests over the cost of living and struggling public services, Katya Adler writes.

breaking_news.headline: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
breaking_news.summary: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic says it will commit 5% of its shares to 'public benefit fund'
breaking_news.summary: The announcement comes as Anthropic lays the ground for a blockbuster stock market listing.

breaking_news.headline: EU tariffs aimed at China hitting Ukraine, steel boss says
breaking_news.summary: The boss of one of Ukraine's biggest steel companies says the country has been "bundled together" in measures aimed at curbing cheap imports.

breaking_news.headline: People playing loud music on buses could face £100 fine
breaking_news.summary:
Antisocial behaviour on buses in England could lead to fines while a new campaign is also being launched for trains.
A national campaign asking rail passengers "share the carriage, not the noise" is being launched.
